start:
Hi! I find dance events for you right here in Telegram.

Set your city with /city Madrid, then try /events, /today or /weekend. /help lists everything I can do.
help:
/events — upcoming events in your city
/today — what is on today
/weekend — this weekend
/search <text> — find an event by title
/style <name> — events of one dance style
/city <name> — choose your city
/lang en|es|ru — language
/notify on|off — reminders and messages from the site
/stop — forget this chat
unknown: I do not know this command. /help shows what I understand.
cityUsage: Tell me the city, for example: /city Madrid
cityCurrent: Your city is {city}. To change it: /city <name>
cityNotFound: I could not find “{query}”. Check the spelling or try a bigger city nearby.
cityHint: Tip: /city <name> shows only events in your city.
searchUsage: What should I look for? Example: /search lindy
styleNotFound: I do not know the style “{query}”.
langUsage: Choose a language: /lang en, /lang es or /lang ru
notifyUsage: Notifications are {state}. Change with /notify on or /notify off
notifyOn: Notifications are on. I will send reminders, cancellations, partner matches and new messages here.
notifyNeedsLink: To receive notifications, connect this chat to your account: open your notification settings on the site and press “Connect Telegram”.
linked: This chat is now connected to your account. Notifications are on; /notify off turns them off.
linkInvalid: This link has expired or was already used. Create a new one in your settings on the site.
linkPrivate: Please open the link in a private chat with me.
stopped: Done: I have forgotten this chat, its city and its account connection. /start begins again.
